|-----------|----------------|----------------|-----------|
| Sports City | 20.2% (HIGH) | AED 1,518 (TRX‑026) | 6.47% |
| Bluewaters Island | 17.6% (HIGH) | AED 2,177 (TRX‑063) | 4.06% |
| JVC (Jumeirah Village Circle) | 15.9% (HIGH) | AED 1,461 (Community) | 7.09% |
